meta.src: Gaia DR3 (ESA/Gaia/DPAC): gaia_source, astrophysical_parameters (GSP-Phot, FLAME), hipparcos2_best_neighbour; HYG v4.4 (astronexus, CC BY-SA 4.0) for names, V, B-V, spectral types; GCVS 5.1 variables
meta.sel: Gaia DR3 G < 7.0, or d <= 30.66 pc with parallax_over_error > 10 and RUWE < 1.4; excluding the 1069 stars of stars.json
meta.ids: HYG id where the star is in HYG; otherwise 1000000 + rank by Gaia source_id (local to this version; use 'gaia' as the stable identifier)
